title: Martyrdom of Senior Brother
next_chapter_hook: Just as everyone thought the crisis had passed, an elderly yet familiar voice rang out in Chen Ji's mind: 'Well done, lad. But the real trial has just begun...'

text.content: Ling Yuan's sinister grin lingered like an inescapable curse in the morning mist. Before Chen Ji could dwell on this unease, a wretched scream echoed from the sect's perimeter. 'Remnants of the Five Elders!' someone cried out. Chen Ji's gaze turned ice-cold—these desperate survivors' last-ditch struggles were often more ferocious than their masters'. He vanished in a flash, following the sound, yet a bitter irony stirred within: the satisfaction of crippling Ling Yuan had barely faded before trouble came knocking. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul trembled faintly, as if warning of something.

dialogue.content: Don't engage! Protect the injured disciples and fall back!

text.content: Though not booming, the voice carried undeniable authority. Chen Ji landed at the edge of the chaos, his gaze sweeping the battlefield like a hawk's. Three black-clad assassins moved like phantoms among the disciples, their blade light leaving trails of blooming blood. Their cultivation was modest, but their strikes were ruthless, targeting vital points with precision. This was the madness of men with nothing left to lose—they knew they wouldn't survive, so they aimed to drag a few others into the abyss.

Before Chen Ji could finish, a black-clad assassin had slithered like a venomous snake behind Senior Brother Zhao Yue. Zhao Yue was the sect's senior brother, once having publicly mocked Chen Ji as 'good-for-nothing trash' in front of everyone. Now he fought desperately to shield the wounded junior disciples behind him, unaware that death crept toward his back. Chen Ji's eyes narrowed, his body moving faster than his thoughts—his 'Wind-Treading Step' technique activated, and before the afterimage even faded, he stood before Zhao Yue.

dialogue.content: This blade, I'll take for Senior Brother!

text.content: A flash of astonishment crossed the assassin's eyes, but his blade never wavered. Cold light gleamed as it thrust toward Chen Ji's chest. Chen Ji deflected the strike with subtle force using his left hand, yet the blade sliced deep into his right palm—a wound reaching to the bone. Blood gushed forth, staining his chest crimson. Zhao Yue stood frozen in shock—this worthless junior brother, whom he had humiliated countless times, had just shielded him with his own flesh and blood from a blade meant to pierce his heart.

dialogue.content: What are you standing there for? Take them and retreat!

text.content: Chen Ji kicked Zhao Yue back, his right hand already forming a sharp sword aura. He could have easily dodged the blade, yet he chose to trade wounds for a life—because the Tianji Record had already foreseen: if Senior Brother Zhao died, the sect disciples would scatter, and the remnants of the Five Elders would seize the opportunity, leading to unimaginable consequences. More importantly, he remembered three years ago, when everyone had trampled upon him, this arrogant senior brother had secretly slipped him a bottle of bruise salve when no one was watching.

dialogue.content: Debts are debts. Whatever I owed Senior Brother, I repay today in full.

choice.prompt: The assassin's blade surged with ferocious intensity, and Chen Ji had already sustained serious wounds—should he fight swiftly to finish this, or delay and wait for reinforcements?

choices.text: Trade wounds for the enemy's life—slay the assassin swiftly
choices.description: Seize the moment when the black-clad assassin's blade hasn't fully recovered, strike vital points with the 'Tianji Sword Art,' end the battle as quickly as possible—but this will worsen existing injuries.
choices.visible_cost: Injuries worsen; excessive blood loss may cause fainting
choices.visible_reward: Stun the entire assembly; spread fearsome reputation far and wide
choices.risk_hint: If strength fails, may fall into even more perilous circumstances

text.content: Cold light blazed in Chen Ji's eyes. His left palm thrust forward with the second move of 'Tianji Palm'—'Against the Current'—forcing the assassin's blade momentum violently backward. The assassin's pupils constricted, feeling as though the youth before him was an entirely different person, with no trace of the good-for-nothing.

choices.text: Steadfast defense and counterattack; wait for the opportune moment
choices.description: Defend to attack; exhaust the assassin's stamina, wait for sect masters' support, ensure personal safety—but risk being surrounded.
choices.visible_reward: Preserve oneself; counter-kill once reinforcements arrive
choices.risk_hint: If reinforcements are delayed, may miss the critical opportunity

text.content: Chen Ji snorted coldly, his footwork shifting sideways to shield the injured Senior Brother behind him. The 'Wind-Treading Step' displayed even greater finesse in its defensive stance, each evasion precisely avoiding vital points. The black-clad assassins' blades were perilously deadly, yet Chen Ji eluded each by the narrowest margin.

dialogue.content: Want to kill me? Come back and practice for another ten years.

text.content: Sword qi broke through the air, carrying biting killing intent directly aimed at the black-clad assassin's throat. The assassin showed utter terror, desperately raising his blade to parry, but a crisp 'clang' rang out as his long sword flew from his grasp. He instinctively retreated three steps, only to be struck in the chest by Chen Ji's other palm, groaning as he was sent flying backward. However, just then, the other two assassins lunged simultaneously, their blade light weaving into a net that completely surrounded Chen Ji. Blood dripped down his arm, yet Chen Ji remained expressionless, his lips even curving into a hint of playful amusement.

dialogue.content: Three against one and you're still struggling this much! What terrible luck did the Five Elders have to raise such useless trash?

text.content: Chen Ji's words were like sharp blades, each character striking at the heart. The three black-clad assassins' faces turned ashen, yet they had no retort. They were indeed the most worthless disciples among the Five Elders, their cultivation so meager that they could only engage in assassination and sneak attacks. Chen Ji stood with hands clasped behind his back, blood still flowing from his wounds, yet his imposing presence completely dominated the three. The surrounding disciples witnessed this scene, all stunned speechless—when had this 'waste' Senior Brother, whom they had mocked for three years, become so terrifying?

dialogue.content: Senior Brother, why are you still standing there? Take the junior disciples and leave now!

text.content: Chen Ji called out without turning, his voice lacking its earlier ferocity, replaced by an unexpected gentleness. Zhao Yue stood frozen, lips quivering yet unable to utter a single word. Three years ago, he had humiliated this young man before the entire sect, calling him worthless; three years later, this 'waste' he had trampled beneath his feet was shielding him with flesh and blood from a deadly blade. The deep, bone-cutting wound still bled profusely, piercing his eyes with its stark reminder.

dialogue.content: Still hesitating? Waiting until I'm dead before leaving? Get out of here now!

choice.prompt: Wounded and alone facing three enemies, Chen Ji must pacify Senior Brother Zhao Yue, who once humiliated him.

choices.description: Using gentle words to comfort Zhao Yue, openly stating that he was not truly trying to make things difficult back then, dissolving his guilt.
choices.visible_reward: Zhao Yue weeps with guilt, vowing loyalty
choices.risk_hint: The enemy might seize the opportunity to counterattack

dialogue.content: The bottle of medicinal wine Senior Brother gave me three years ago, I've always remembered it.

text.content: Chen Ji's voice was calm, as if speaking of something insignificant. Yet it was precisely this calmness that completely broke Zhao Yue's defenses—of course he remembered. That bottle of medicinal wine was the only moment he had shown Chen Ji kindness, never expecting this youth to have kept it in his heart all along.

choices.text: Proud declaration, winning respect through strength
choices.description: Declaring his rise with a strong person's posture, clarifying that saving someone was based on righteousness, not weakness, making Zhao Yue completely convinced.
choices.visible_reward: Zhao Yue's reverence transforms into complete submission

dialogue.content: Back then you called me waste, and I didn't argue because I couldn't be bothered to argue. Now that I'm being a little serious, you can't take it?

text.content: Chen Ji's words were calm, yet they exploded like thunder. The three black-clad assassins' faces turned deathly pale, their hands trembling as they gripped their blades. The surrounding disciples were silent as the grave, their gazes toward Chen Ji shifting from contempt to profound reverence.

Just then, an ancient voice transmitted from the Void—it was the remnant soul of Mo Xiansheng. 'Boy, a powerful expert approaches from behind. Their cultivation is at least at the late Foundation Building stage. Not an enemy, but the visitor comes with ill intent.' Chen Ji's eyes flickered, his heart growing wary. Late Foundation Building? Within the Tianqing Sect, such powerful old monsters could be counted on one's fingers. Before he could think further, the three black-clad assassins launched their simultaneous attack, blade light interweaving into a net of death.

Chen Ji drew a deep breath, the Tianji Record pulsing warmly within his Mental Sea. Consuming 5 Heavenly Fate points to gain foresight for three breaths—he saw: the left assassin's blade was fastest, but his strength was already exhausted; the middle assassin was a feint; the right assassin was the true killing stroke. A cold smirk curved his lips as his form flickered like a specter.

dialogue.content: A trivial trick—dare you show off your skills before a master?

text.content: Chen Ji first slapped away the blade of the assassin on the left, then sidestepped the seemingly fierce but feigned strike from the middle, and finally caught the deadly blow from the assassin on the right with the third form of the Tianji Palm—'Break Illusion.' Palm and blade clashed, waves of qi surged, and the black-clad assassin grunted, stumbling backward. Yet Chen Ji himself suffered torn wounds, blood staining half his body.

choice.prompt: Chen Ji stands blood-soaked, the three assassins suppressed, but a hidden expert is approaching—is this the moment to press the attack or to pull back?

choices.text: Eliminate the roots and leave no future troubles.
choices.description: While the three assassins are in disarray, deliver a fatal blow to completely eliminate hidden dangers, but this may expose more of one's true strength.
choices.visible_cost: Physical exhaustion has set in—the hidden expert may have sensed something abnormal.
choices.visible_reward: Permanently eliminate all troubles and greatly enhance one's reputation.
choices.risk_hint: The abilities of the Tianji Record may be exposed.

text.content: Chen's killing intent surged violently. His right hand gathered sword qi into a cold light. His figure flickered like lightning, instantly crossing before the throats of three assassins. Blood splashed, three figures froze in place, then collapsed with a thunderous crash. Clean, decisive, without the slightest hesitation.

choices.text: Pull back at the peak of success and preserve one's strength.
choices.description: After deterring the enemy, retreat proactively, keep the trump cards hidden, and avoid the hidden expert glimpsing one's true strength.
choices.visible_reward: Hide one's strength and avoid exposure.

text.content: Chen Ji snorted coldly, sheathing his sword qi as he turned toward Zhao Yue and the others. His back appeared exceptionally proud and aloof amidst the blood mist. The three black-clad men exchanged glances, yet not one dared step forward to pursue. By the time their master realized what had happened, Chen Ji had vanished into the morning mist.

The battle ended, morning mist gradually dissipating. The injured disciples were helped back toward the sect's interior. Zhao Yue, however, knelt before Chen Ji, refusing to rise for a long time. His eyes were red, tears mixing with blood stained his entire face, his voice choked with sobs nearly impossible to hear. 'Chen Junior Brother... I... I've wronged you...' Three years ago, that humiliation pressed down on his heart like a thousand pounds, making it almost impossible to breathe. The surrounding junior brothers and sisters were all stunned—they had never seen their proud and domineering Senior Brother lower his head to anyone.

dialogue.content: Rise, Senior Brother. The past, I have never dwelled upon.

text.content: Chen Ji extended his blood-stained hand, helping Zhao Yue to his feet. His tone was flat, as if truly speaking of something insignificant. Yet only he knew that this 'never dwelled upon' was the greatest lie. The Tianji Record clearly documented those humiliations—every mockery, every contemptuous glance, every 'waste' hurled at him. He remembered it all, not a single moment forgotten. But today, blocking that blade made those memories suddenly seem less important. Not because he had let go, but because—he had long stood at a height they could never reach.

dialogue.content: From this day forth, any enemy of the Tianqing Sect's disciples shall be my enemy. Whoever dares touch a single hair of yours, I shall repay them a hundredfold!

text.content: Chen's voice wasn't loud, yet it clearly reached everyone's ears. The surrounding disciples first froze in shock, then their eyes grew red one by one. They recalled their past cold mockery of Chen Ji, remembered following Senior Brother in ridiculing him as waste—and today, this boy they had trampled beneath their feet had blocked a lethal blade with his flesh and blood for them. Guilt, gratitude, admiration... various emotions intertwined, causing many to shed tears on the spot. Zhao Yue wept even more uncontrollably, kowtowing heavily three times: 'Chen Junior Brother's great kindness—I, Zhao Yue, dare not forget this lifetime!'

Just as everyone's emotions ran high, a faint voice echoed in Chen Ji's Mental Sea—it was the transmission from Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul, carrying a hint of approval: 'Well done, child. Your choice today brings this old master great satisfaction.' Chen Ji felt a stir in his heart, yet his expression remained unchanged. He knew the true test might have just begun. That hidden Foundation Building expert ultimately did not reveal themselves—this filled Chen Ji with a lingering unease. Ling Yuan's sinister smile before being废除, Mo Xiansheng's transmission, the mysterious Foundation Building expert...这一切似乎都指向某个他尚未看透的棋局。

dialogue.content: 'Come to the stone pavilion at the Rear Mountain. There's something to give you.'

text.content: Mo Xiansheng's voice gradually faded, yet Chen Ji stood motionless for a long while. He raised his gaze toward the sect's Rear Mountain, his eyes deep and unfathomable. Today's events, on the surface, were a drama of assassin attack and hero saving the beauty, but Chen Ji always sensed an invisible hand pushing things from behind. Why would the Five Elders' remnants act at this moment? Was Ling Yuan's废除 connected to this attack? What was the background of that Foundation Building expert who never revealed themselves? These questions coiled in his mind like tangled hemp. Though the Tianji Record could foresee events within three hours, it could not trace deeper cause and effect. He took a deep breath and stepped toward the Rear Mountain. There awaited a truth he must face.
